title: Anatomy of a run: The Terra Luna crash
title_zh: 运行机制剖析：Terra Luna崩溃事件
title_primary: 运行机制剖析：Terra Luna崩溃事件
title_secondary: Anatomy of a run: The Terra Luna crash
authors: Jiageng Liu, Igor Makarov, Antoinette Schoar
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine the dramatic collapse of the Terra blockchain in May 2022. Using granular blockchain data, we show that the run resulted from the interaction of three economic forces: subsidized money creation, real-time observability of transactions, and investor concentration. The early success of Terra’s algorithmic stablecoin, UST, was fueled by highly subsidized deposit rates, which attracted many investors but failed to engage them meaningfully with other services. Blockchain transparency allowed investors to observe Terra’s worsening fundamentals and monitor each other’s exits in real time. Larger and sophisticated investors reacted faster to adverse signals and served as catalysts for the run. These findings challenge the idea that blockchain transparency levels the playing field and highlight how greater observability and concentration can amplify financial fragility. Our results contribute to the understanding of the limits of private money creation and the dynamics of runs in fully digital financial systems.
abstract_zh: 我们审视了2022年5月Terra区块链的戏剧性崩溃。利用细粒度区块链数据，我们表明，此次挤兑源于三种经济力量的相互作用：补贴性货币创造、交易的实时可观测性以及投资者集中度。Terra算法稳定币UST的早期成功，得益于高补贴的存款利率，这吸引了众多投资者，但未能使他们有意义地参与其他服务。区块链的透明度使投资者能够观察到Terra日益恶化的基本面，并实时监控彼此的退出行为。规模较大且经验丰富的投资者对不利信号反应更快，成为挤兑的催化剂。这些发现挑战了区块链透明度能拉平竞争环境的观点，并强调了更高的可观测性和集中度如何放大金融脆弱性。我们的研究结果有助于理解私人货币创造的局限性以及全数字金融系统中挤兑的动态机制。

title: Validating Hospital Quality Indicators and the Causal Effect of Hospital Closures
title_zh: 验证医院质量指标与医院关闭的因果效应
title_primary: 验证医院质量指标与医院关闭的因果效应

authors: Chandra, Amitabh, Dalton, Maurice, Staiger, Douglas O.
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We evaluate the validity of commonly used hospital quality indicators using hospital closures that reallocate large numbers of patients to hospitals of different quality. Using over 20 years of Medicare claims for over 30 million patients admitted with five common diagnoses, we find that hospital quality indicators overstate the causal impact of hospitals on mortality and readmission rates by less than 10% but overstate hospital impacts on inpatient cost and length of stay by closer to 40%. On average, hospital closures reduce patient mortality by shifting patients to higher quality hospitals, but the effect varies widely.

title: Crypto Capture of Foreign Aid
title_zh: 加密货币对外国援助的俘获
title_primary: 加密货币对外国援助的俘获
title_secondary: Crypto Capture of Foreign Aid
authors: Sumit Agarwal, Peiyi Jin, Eswar S. Prasad, Daniel Rabetti
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The 2016 Panama Papers leak tightened regulatory enforcement around money laundering and offshore banking. We investigate whether the diversion of foreign aid in developing countries led to a shift to cryptocurrency as an alternative laundering platform. We develop a disbursement-timed forensic measure of cryptocurrency activity, combining on-chain Bitcoin transactions and wallet creation, off-chain exchange records, and IP-linked web traffic, and apply it to World Bank aid disbursements covering $238 billion across the 93 recipient countries in our estimation sample during 2018-2024. Exploiting the administrative timing of aid tranche arrivals, we find sharp, short-lived surges of crypto activity at the disbursement month, driven mainly by anonymous and newly created wallets on both tax-haven and mainstream exchanges. Blockchain forensics reveal patterns consistent with the placement, layering, and integration sequence of conventional money laundering. We estimate an implied leakage of 2 to 6 cents per aid dollar, which amounts to roughly 1.7 to 4.4 billion dollars of aid diversion across the tranche arrivals we study. Capture carries no funding penalty: the four sectors where we detect it, Transport, Water and Sanitation, Social Protection, and Governance, still absorb half of subsequent World Bank funding. Cryptocurrency facilitates aid diversion, but its transparent ledgers also leave forensic traces that may help detect and recover diverted funds.
abstract_zh: 2016年巴拿马文件泄露事件加强了围绕洗钱和离岸银行业务的监管执法。我们研究发展中国家对外援助的转移是否导致了向加密货币作为替代洗钱平台的转变。我们开发了一种基于支付时间点的法证测量方法，结合链上比特币交易和钱包创建、链下交易所记录以及IP关联的网络流量，并将其应用于世界银行2018-2024年间覆盖我们估计样本中93个受援国、总额达2380亿美元的援助支付。利用援助款项分批到账的行政时间安排，我们发现援助支付当月加密货币活动出现急剧且短暂的激增，主要由匿名和新创建的钱包在避税天堂和主流交易所驱动。区块链取证揭示了与传统洗钱中的放置、分层和整合阶段相一致的模式。我们估计每援助美元隐含泄漏2至6美分，在我们研究的款项到账事件中，相当于约17亿至44亿美元的援助转移。被捕获的转移行为不带来资金惩罚：我们检测到转移的四个部门——交通、供水和卫生、社会保护以及治理——仍然吸收了世界银行后续资金的一半。加密货币便利了援助转移，但其透明账本也留下了可能有助于检测和追回被转移资金的取证痕迹。

title: Geopolitical risk and emerging market sovereign risk premia
title_zh: 地缘政治风险与新兴市场主权风险溢价
title_primary: 地缘政治风险与新兴市场主权风险溢价
title_secondary: Geopolitical risk and emerging market sovereign risk premia
authors: Gamboa-Estrada, Fredy, Romero, José, Romero, José Vicente
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This study examines how geopolitical risk (GPR) transmits to sovereign credit risk in emerging market economies (EMEs), using monthly data on the 5-year sovereign credit default swap (SCDS) and the J.P. Morgan Emerging Markets Bond Index (EMBI) spread for 13 EMEs over the period of January 2005–October 2025. Using fixed-effects panel local projections, the framework is extended to allow for state-dependent transmission. Differences in impulse responses across states are attributed to specific macrofinancial fundamentals. Three main findings are identified. First, an increase in the GPR index raises both SCDS and EMBI spreads. Second, disaggregating the index into its subcomponents reveals a larger response to threats than to acts, consistent with the possibility of anticipation effects in sovereign credit markets. Third, evaluating the state-dependent impulse response around the Russian invasion of Ukraine yields substantially different responses, with the post-invasion configuration increasing the sovereign risk premia response. Our findings show the importance of modeling the state-dependent transmission of geopolitical shocks and provide a useful tool for incorporating geopolitical scenarios into sovereign risk analysis.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察地缘政治风险（GPR）如何传导至新兴市场经济体（EMEs）的主权信用风险，利用2005年1月至2025年10月期间13个新兴市场经济体的5年期主权信用违约互换（SCDS）和摩根大通新兴市场债券指数（EMBI）利差的月度数据。采用固定效应面板局部投影法，将框架扩展至允许状态依赖的传导效应。不同状态下脉冲响应的差异归因于特定的宏观金融基本面因素。研究得出三项主要发现。第一，GPR指数的上升同时推高SCDS和EMBI利差。第二，将指数分解为其子成分后发现，对威胁的反应大于对实际行动的反应，这与主权信用市场中存在预期效应的可能性一致。第三，围绕俄罗斯入侵乌克兰事件评估状态依赖的脉冲响应，显示出显著不同的反应，入侵后的状态配置放大了主权风险溢价响应。我们的研究结果表明，对地缘政治冲击的状态依赖传导进行建模具有重要意义，并为将地缘政治情景纳入主权风险分析提供了实用工具。

title: Testing for underpowered literatures
title_zh: 检验低功效文献
title_primary: 检验低功效文献
title_secondary: Testing for underpowered literatures
authors: Stefan Faridani
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: How many experimental studies would have come to different conclusions had they been run on larger samples? I show how to estimate the expected number of statistically significant results that a set of experiments would have reported had their sample sizes all been counterfactually increased. The proposed deconvolution estimator is asymptotically normal and adjusts for publication bias. Unlike related methods, this approach requires no assumptions of any kind about the distribution of true intervention treatment effects and allows for point masses. Simulations find good coverage even when the t-score is only approximately normal. An application to randomized trials (RCTs) published in economics journals finds that doubling every sample would increase the power of t-tests by 7.2 percentage points on average. This effect is smaller than for non-RCTs and comparable to systematic replications in laboratory psychology where previous studies enabled more accurate power calculations. This suggests that RCTs are on average relatively insensitive to sample size increases. Research funders who wish to raise power should generally consider sponsoring better-measured and higher quality experiments -- rather than only larger ones.
abstract_zh: 如果有更多实验研究在更大样本量下进行，它们会得出多少不同的结论？我展示了如何估计一组实验在样本量均被反事实增加的情况下，原本会报告出的统计显著结果数量的期望值。所提出的反卷积估计量渐近正态，并对发表偏倚进行了调整。与相关方法不同，此方法无需对真实干预处理效应的分布做出假设，并允许存在点质量。模拟结果显示，即使t分数仅近似正态，覆盖率也表现良好。应用于经济学期刊上发表的随机对照试验（RCTs）发现，将每个样本量加倍会使t检验的平均功效提高7.2个百分点。这一效应小于非随机对照试验，并与实验室心理学中的系统性重复研究相当，后者先前的研究使得功效计算更为精确。这表明随机对照试验平均而言对样本量增加的敏感性相对较低。希望提高功效的研究资助者通常应考虑资助测量更精确、质量更高的实验——而不仅仅是规模更大的实验。

title: Panel Stochastic Frontier Models with Latent Group Structures
title_zh: 具有潜在分组结构的面板随机前沿模型
title_primary: 具有潜在分组结构的面板随机前沿模型
title_secondary: Panel Stochastic Frontier Models with Latent Group Structures
authors: Kazuki Tomioka, Thomas T. Yang, Xibin Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Stochastic frontier models have attracted considerable attention due to the incorporation of an inefficiency term in addition to the conventional error term. In this paper, we propose a general estimation framework for panel stochastic frontier models that accommodates potential heterogeneity through latent group structures. The framework is tailored to the distinctive features of stochastic frontier models and is paired with a practical hybrid estimation procedure that combines individual-level and joint panel estimation. We illustrate the estimation framework using a panel stochastic frontier model that treats the inefficiency term as a random effect, and show that it can be readily extended to a range of fixed effects specifications common in the literature. Simulation studies indicate strong finite-sample performance, and we further demonstrate the practicality of the approach in an empirical application to the cost efficiency of the U.S. commercial banking sector.
abstract_zh: 随机前沿模型因在传统误差项之外引入无效率项而受到广泛关注。本文提出了一种适用于面板随机前沿模型的通用估计框架，该框架通过潜在群组结构来容纳异质性。此框架针对随机前沿模型的独特特征量身定制，并配以结合个体层面与联合面板估计的实用混合估计程序。我们以一个将无效率项视为随机效应的面板随机前沿模型为例说明该估计框架，并展示其可便捷地扩展至文献中常见的多种固定效应设定。模拟研究表明该方法具有较强的小样本表现，且我们进一步通过一项针对美国商业银行部门成本效率的实证应用，展示了该方法的实用性。

title: Suspicion and communication
title_zh: 怀疑与沟通
title_primary: 怀疑与沟通
title_secondary: Suspicion and communication
authors: Lisa Bruttel, Friedericke Fromme, Vasilisa Werner
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: 来源期次 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In this paper, we study how communication influences suspicion. The experiment uses a sender–receiver setup with a low probability of misaligned incentives for senders and receivers. We focus on the impact of open communication on the receivers’ suspicion as measured by the size of the deviation from the senders’ recommendation before and after the communication. Overall, communication substantially reduces suspicion, but some receivers become more suspicious during the communication. We disentangle these effects using machine learning methods to analyze the chat logs.
abstract_zh: 本文研究沟通如何影响猜疑。实验采用发送者-接收者设置，其中发送者与接收者的激励错位概率较低。我们聚焦于开放式沟通对接收者猜疑的影响，以沟通前后偏离发送者建议的程度来衡量。总体而言，沟通显著降低了猜疑，但部分接收者在沟通过程中变得更加猜疑。我们利用机器学习方法分析聊天记录，以厘清这些效应。

title: Technology overload? macroeconomic implications of accelerated obsolescence
title_zh: 技术过载？加速淘汰的宏观经济影响
title_primary: 技术过载？加速淘汰的宏观经济影响
title_secondary: Technology overload? macroeconomic implications of accelerated obsolescence
authors: Seda Basihos
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Since the mid-1990s computing revolution, the U.S. economy has exhibited several striking regularities. Labor productivity growth has slowed below its historical trend following a decade-long boom, while the labor share has declined. Computing technologies are characterized by rapid obsolescence, and U.S. data suggest that aggregate capital obsolescence has accelerated since their widespread adoption. I study the macroeconomic implications of this acceleration using an endogenous growth model in which the economy transitions to a new equilibrium with a higher obsolescence rate. As capital designs become obsolete sooner, the value of future payoffs to capital innovation initially falls. The economy responds with a temporary productivity boom driven by faster skill accumulation, which partially restores innovation profitability. Over time, however, efficient capital per efficient labor declines. Under factor complementarity, this scarcity depresses the labor share by raising flow profits accruing to capital designs relative to skills. Resources are redirected from skill creation toward short-lived capital innovation, ultimately slowing long-run growth. The calibrated model produces productivity and labor-share dynamics broadly consistent with the data, and the paper advances the obsolescence channel as one plausible account of these trends.
abstract_zh: 自20世纪90年代中期计算革命以来，美国经济呈现出若干显著规律性特征。在经历长达十年的繁荣期后，劳动生产率增速已放缓至历史趋势线以下，同时劳动收入份额持续下降。计算技术具有快速过时的特性，美国数据表明，自其广泛普及以来，总体资本过时速度已显著加快。本文通过构建内生增长模型研究这一加速现象对宏观经济的影响，在该模型中经济将向具有更高过时率的新均衡状态过渡。随着资本设计过时速度加快，资本创新未来收益的现值最初出现下降。经济通过技能积累加速形成暂时性生产率繁荣作为应对，这在一定程度上恢复了创新盈利能力。然而，单位有效劳动的有效资本存量随时间推移持续下降。在要素互补性条件下，这种稀缺性通过提高资本设计相对于技能所获得的流动利润，压低了劳动收入份额。资源从技能创造转向短寿命资本创新，最终导致长期增长放缓。校准模型产生的生产率与劳动份额动态与数据基本吻合，本文提出过时渠道作为解释这些趋势的合理机制之一。

title: Maternal Investments in Children: The Role of Expected Effort and Returns
title_zh: 母亲对子女的投资：预期努力与回报的作用
title_primary: 母亲对子女的投资：预期努力与回报的作用
title_secondary: Maternal Investments in Children: The Role of Expected Effort and Returns
authors: Bhalotra, Sonia, Delavande, Adeline, Font, Paulino, Maselko, Joanna
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We investigate the importance of subjective expectations of returns to and effort costs of the two principal investments that mothers make in newborns: breastfeeding and stimulation. We find heterogeneity across mothers in rural Pakistan in expected effort costs and expected returns for outcomes in the cognitive, socio-emotional and health domains, and that this contributes to explaining heterogeneity in investments. We find no significant differences across women in preferences for child developmental outcomes. We simulate the impact of alternative policies on investments. Our findings highlight the relevance of interventions designed to address maternal depression and reduce perinatal fatigue alongside interventions that increase perceived returns to investments.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了母亲对新生儿的两项主要投资——母乳喂养和刺激——的预期回报与努力成本的主观重要性。在巴基斯坦农村地区，我们发现母亲们在认知、社会情感和健康领域的结果预期努力成本和预期回报上存在异质性，并且这种异质性有助于解释投资上的差异。我们发现，在儿童发展结果的偏好上，女性之间没有显著差异。我们模拟了不同政策对投资的影响。研究结果强调了针对母亲抑郁和减少围产期疲劳的干预措施，以及提高投资感知回报的干预措施的相关性。

title: Health Insurance and Access to Care for the Near Elderly
title_zh: 健康保险与准老年人医疗可及性
title_primary: 健康保险与准老年人医疗可及性
title_secondary: Health Insurance and Access to Care for the Near Elderly
authors: Anderson, Michael, Dobkin, Carlos, Maestas, Nicole, Rose, Liam
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Economic Policy · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: The vast majority of Americans become eligible for Medicare at age 65. This results in 7 percent of the near elderly transitioning from uninsurance to insurance and 60 percent switching from some source of insurance to Medicare. We develop an extension of two-sample IV to estimate the effect of uninsurance on access to care while accounting for the effects of the other transitions. We find that not having insurance results in much lower probabilities of having a medical provider or receiving inpatient care. The foregone hospitalizations are for life-threatening emergent conditions and elective surgeries that increase quality of life.
abstract_zh: 绝大多数美国人在65岁时获得Medicare资格。这导致7%的临近老年人群从无保险状态转为有保险，60%的人群从其他保险来源转向Medicare。我们开发了双样本工具变量法的扩展方法，在考虑其他保险转换影响的同时，估计无保险状态对医疗服务可及性的影响。研究发现，缺乏保险会显著降低拥有医疗服务提供者或接受住院治疗的概率。被放弃的住院治疗涉及危及生命的紧急病症以及提升生活质量的择期手术。

title: Returns to Inventors
title_zh: 发明者的回报
title_primary: 发明者的回报
title_secondary: Returns to Inventors
authors: Otto Toivanen, Lotta Väänänen
official: 聚合元数据日期 2012-02-07 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: A key input to inventive activity is human capital. Hence, it is important to understand the monetary incentives of inventors. We estimate the effect of patented inventions on individual earnings by linking data on U.S. patents and their inventors to Finnish employer-employee data. Returns are heterogeneous: inventors get a temporary reward of 3% of annual earnings for a patent grant and for highly cited patents a longer-lasting premium of 30% in earnings three years later. Similar medium-term premium's accrue to inventors who initially hold the patent rights, although they forgo earnings at the time of the grant.
abstract_zh: 发明活动的关键投入是人力资本。因此，理解发明者的货币激励至关重要。我们通过将美国专利及其发明者数据与芬兰雇主-雇员数据相关联，估算了专利发明对个人收入的影响。回报呈现异质性：发明者因获得专利授权可获得相当于年收入3%的临时奖励，而对于高被引专利，三年后其收入可获得30%的长期溢价。类似的中期溢价也适用于最初持有专利权的发明者，尽管他们在专利授权时放弃了部分收入。

title: How Worker Productivity and Wages Grow with Tenure and Experience: The Firm Perspective
title_zh: 任期与经验如何促进工人生产率与工资增长：企业视角
title_primary: 任期与经验如何促进工人生产率与工资增长：企业视角
title_secondary: How Worker Productivity and Wages Grow with Tenure and Experience: The Firm Perspective
authors: Caplin, Andrew, Lee, Minjoon, Leth-Petersen, Søren, Shapiro, Matthew D.
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Macroeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: How worker productivity evolves with tenure and experience shapes life-cycle earnings and losses from job separation. Yet, worker-level productivity is hard to identify from observational data. This paper introduces a firm survey designed to separate effects of on-the-job tenure from sector-specific experience on the trajectory of on-the-job productivity. Several findings emerge. (i) On-the-job productivity growth initially exceeds wage growth, consistent with wages not being allocative period-by-period. (ii) Previous sector-specific experience reduces on-the-job tenure needed, though not by one-to-one, to reach a maximal productivity. (iii) There is substantial heterogeneity across jobs in the extent that previous sector-specific experience reduces tenure needed.
abstract_zh: 工人生产率随任期与经验的演变，决定了生命周期内的收入水平及失业造成的损失。然而，从观测数据中识别工人层面的生产率存在困难。本文引入一项企业调查，旨在分离在职任期与行业特定经验对在职生产率轨迹的影响。研究得出以下发现：（i）在职生产率的初始增长超过工资增长，这与工资并非逐期配置性调整的结论一致；（ii）先前的行业特定经验可缩短达到最大生产率所需的在职任期，但并非完全替代关系；（iii）不同岗位中，先前行业特定经验对缩短所需任期的影响存在显著异质性。

title: Voice and distortion: When representatives misread the room
title_zh: 声音与扭曲：当代表们误判局势时
title_primary: 声音与扭曲：当代表们误判局势时
title_secondary: Voice and distortion: When representatives misread the room
authors: Kirill Chernomaz
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: A representative chooses policy on behalf of a group with heterogeneous preferences. Group members differ in voice (their salience to the representative). The representative maximizes perceived welfare based on a voice-weighted signal. The resulting policy distortion is proportional to the covariance between voice and preferences. When agents choose voice effort endogenously, equilibrium voice is U-shaped (quadratic in distance between preferences and policy). The equilibrium distortion is approximately one-third of a standard deviation times the skewness coefficient. It is non-zero only when the preference distribution is skewed. Combining the voice-weighted signal with a random sample can reduce the expected welfare loss. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
abstract_zh: 一位代表代表一个偏好异质性的群体制定政策。群体成员在话语权（即其对代表的重要性）上存在差异。代表基于话语权加权的信号最大化感知福利。由此产生的政策扭曲与话语权和偏好之间的协方差成正比。当代理人内生地选择话语努力时，均衡话语呈U形（即偏好与政策距离的二次函数）。均衡扭曲约为标准差的三分之一乘以偏度系数。只有当偏好分布呈偏态时，该扭曲才非零。将话语权加权信号与随机样本相结合，可以减少预期福利损失。

title: Voter preferences, party politics and environmental policy reform
title_zh: 选民偏好、政党政治与环境政策改革
title_primary: 选民偏好、政党政治与环境政策改革
title_secondary: Voter preferences, party politics and environmental policy reform
authors: Martin W. Adler, Stefanie Peer, António Russo
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Policymakers frequently implement environmental policies that are less ambitious than what voters would prefer. We document this gap using findings from previous research as well as evidence from climate policy in Austria's transport sector. To account for this pattern, we develop a model in which political parties compete with electoral platforms that involve multiple policy dimensions. When voters place greater weight on a primary issue -such as fiscal policy - than on environmental policy, we show that parties may refrain from proposing environmental reforms, even when these reforms enjoy broad public support. This dynamic arises once the primary issue becomes sufficiently salient to voters. We then examine potential ways to overcome this policy inertia, including the use of direct democratic instruments (e.g., referendums) and the delegation of environmental policy decisions from national to regional governments.
abstract_zh: 政策制定者经常实施的环境政策力度低于选民期望的水平。我们利用既有研究成果以及奥地利交通部门气候政策的实证证据，揭示了这一差距。为解释这一现象，我们构建了一个模型，其中政党在涉及多个政策维度的选举纲领中展开竞争。当选民对财政政策等首要议题的重视程度超过环境政策时，研究表明即使环境改革获得广泛公众支持，政党也可能放弃提出相关改革方案。这种动态机制在首要议题对选民具有足够显著重要性时便会显现。随后我们探讨了克服这种政策惯性的潜在路径，包括运用直接民主工具（如公投）以及将环境政策决策权从国家政府下放至地区政府。

title: Strategic Stake Acquisitions in Rival Firms: Common vs. Cross‐Ownership
title_zh: 竞争对手企业中的战略性股权收购：共同所有权与交叉所有权
title_primary: 竞争对手企业中的战略性股权收购：共同所有权与交叉所有权
title_secondary: Strategic Stake Acquisitions in Rival Firms: Common vs. Cross‐Ownership
authors: Vincenzo Denicolò, Fausto Panunzi
official: 官方在线 2026-07-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study how a blockholder who controls a firm should acquire a minority stake in a rival: directly, creating common ownership , or indirectly through the controlled firm, creating cross‐ownership . Common ownership generates stronger internalization of competitive externalities and allows the blockholder to capture the resulting gains without sharing them with dispersed shareholders. However, it may also create conflicts of interest with minority shareholders that can lead to a loss of control. Cross‐ownership avoids this governance risk but internalizes competition less effectively. We characterize how the optimal acquisition mode depends on the nature of product market competition and the strength of corporate governance.
abstract_zh: 我们研究控制一家公司的大股东应如何获取竞争对手的少数股权：是直接获取（形成共同所有权），还是通过所控制的公司间接获取（形成交叉所有权）。共同所有权能更有效地内化竞争外部性，并使大股东在不与分散股东分享收益的情况下获取由此产生的收益。然而，这可能会与少数股东产生利益冲突，进而导致控制权丧失。交叉所有权可规避这种治理风险，但内化竞争的效果较差。我们刻画了最优收购模式如何取决于产品市场竞争的性质以及公司治理的强度。

title: What is core inflation?
title_zh: 什么是核心通胀？
title_primary: 什么是核心通胀？
title_secondary: What is core inflation?
authors: Jonathan H. Wright
official: 官方在线 2026-07-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper revisits the question of what core inflation is meant to represent and assesses the competing measures of core inflation that are available, including some new ones. I take the primary perspective that core inflation is a simple predictor of future headline inflation. There is evidence for ex food and energy, and other core measures, being superior predictors than headline inflation itself. Within choices of core inflation, simple averaging of different measures and different horizons seems to work best. I also consider some other concepts of core inflation: closeness to a common trend component and measurement of demand-driven inflation. The averaging estimator fares well by all of these metrics.
abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了核心通胀旨在代表什么的问题，并评估了可用的竞争性核心通胀衡量指标，包括一些新指标。我主要从核心通胀作为未来总体通胀的简单预测指标这一视角出发。有证据表明，剔除食品和能源后的核心通胀及其他核心指标，在预测能力上优于总体通胀本身。在核心通胀的选择中，对不同指标和不同时间跨度进行简单平均似乎效果最佳。我还考虑了核心通胀的其他概念：与共同趋势成分的接近程度以及需求驱动型通胀的衡量。平均估计量在所有这些指标上均表现良好。

title: Assessing the economic effects of veterinary antimicrobial use reduction policies: China’s experience and worldwide implications
title_zh: 评估兽用抗菌药物减量政策的经济效应：中国经验与全球启示
title_primary: 评估兽用抗菌药物减量政策的经济效应：中国经验与全球启示
title_secondary: Assessing the economic effects of veterinary antimicrobial use reduction policies: China’s experience and worldwide implications
authors: Ruishi Si, Hao Zhao, Sitong Pan, Yongfeng Tan, Mingyue Liu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Mitigating antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in veterinary medicine is critical to achieving the UN 2030 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Most countries have adopted tailored antimicrobial reduction policies in animal production, yet rigorous cost-benefit evaluations remain scarce. We leverage China’s large-scale 2021 veterinary antimicrobial use reduction (AUR) policies as a quasi-natural experiment, employing a Fuzzy Regression Discontinuity (FRD) design to estimate its causal effects on farmers’ net income and disentangle the transmission mechanisms using three-wave panel data from hog farmers (2022–2024). The empirical results demonstrate that the AUR policies exhibited a dynamic pattern of initial income suppression followed by income enhancement, with the estimated effect turning positive in the second year of implementation (2023). Based on the baseline FRD estimates, the average effect over the full panel period is an increase of 186.504–198.708 CNY per head, representing 34.09 %–36.32 % of the three-year average net income. This effect is primarily driven by changes in cost-benefit indicators such as slaughter weight, market premiums, biosecurity expenditures, antimicrobial input costs, and antimicrobial alternative costs. We elucidate the underlying mechanisms through which AUR policy interventions operate, specifically via antimicrobial use regulation, compulsory immunization, antimicrobial-reduction compliance certification, and antimicrobial-reduction technical training. During the AUR’s initial rollout (2022), antimicrobial use regulation was the primary income suppressor, whereas market premiums became the dominant income driver in the maturation phase (2023–2024). Moreover, heterogeneity analysis shows that the income-enhancing effect of the AUR policies was more pronounced among farmers who possessed high digital literacy and had organizational support, compared to those without these advantages. Based onChina’s AUR experience, weproposefive policy insightsthat are particularly relevant fordeveloping-country contexts: optimized policy mixes, tiered biosecurity systems, scalable antimicrobial alternatives, targeted market incentives, and inclusive global governance frameworks.
abstract_zh: 减轻兽医学中的抗菌药物耐药性（AMR）对于实现联合国2030年可持续发展目标（SDGs）至关重要。大多数国家已在动物生产中采纳了定制化的抗菌药物减量政策，然而严格的成本效益评估仍然稀缺。我们利用中国2021年大规模兽用抗菌药物使用减量（AUR）政策作为准自然实验，采用模糊断点回归（FRD）设计，估计其对农户净收入的因果效应，并利用2022至2024年三轮生猪养殖户面板数据解析其传导机制。实证结果表明，AUR政策呈现出先抑制收入后提升收入的动态模式，估计效应在实施第二年（2023年）转为正。基于基线FRD估计，整个面板期间的平均效应为每头增加186.504至198.708元人民币，占三年平均净收入的34.09%至36.32%。这一效应主要由屠宰重量、市场溢价、生物安全支出、抗菌药物投入成本及抗菌药物替代成本等成本效益指标的变化驱动。我们阐明了AUR政策干预发挥作用的内在机制，具体通过抗菌药物使用监管、强制免疫、减抗合规认证及减抗技术培训实现。在AUR初期推行阶段（2022年），抗菌药物使用监管是主要的收入抑制因素，而在成熟阶段（2023至2024年），市场溢价成为主导的收入驱动因素。此外，异质性分析显示，AUR政策的收入提升效应在具备较高数字素养且获得组织支持的养殖户中更为显著，相较于不具备这些优势的养殖户。基于中国的AUR经验，我们提出五项对发展中国家情境尤为相关的政策启示：优化政策组合、分级生物安全体系、可推广的抗菌药物替代方案、精准市场激励以及包容性全球治理框架。

title: Monetary Policy without Commitment
title_zh: 无承诺的货币政策
title_primary: 无承诺的货币政策
title_secondary: Monetary Policy without Commitment
authors: Hassan Afrouzi, Marina Halac, Kenneth Rogoff, Pierre Yared
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper studies the implications of central bank credibility for long-run inflation and inflation dynamics. We introduce central bank lack of commitment into a standard nonlinear New Keynesian economy with sticky-price monopolistically competitive firms. Inflation is driven by the interaction of lack of commitment and the economic environment. We show that long-run inflation increases following an unanticipated permanent increase in the labor wedge or decrease in the elasticity of substitution across varieties. In the transition, inflation overshoots and then gradually declines. Quantitatively, inflation overshooting is persistent, and the welfare loss from lack of commitment relative to inflation targeting is large. (JEL D43, E12, E23, E24, E31, E52, E58)
abstract_zh: 本文研究了中央银行可信度对长期通胀及通胀动态的影响。我们将中央银行缺乏承诺的特征引入标准非线性新凯恩斯经济模型（该模型包含粘性价格与垄断竞争企业）。通胀由缺乏承诺与经济环境的相互作用共同驱动。研究表明，当劳动楔子出现未预期的永久性上升或品种间替代弹性下降时，长期通胀水平将随之上升。在过渡阶段，通胀会出现超调现象，随后逐步回落。从量化角度看，通胀超调具有持续性，且相较于通胀目标制，缺乏承诺导致的福利损失较为显著。（JEL分类号：D43, E12, E23, E24, E31, E52, E58）

title: Dominated Pension Investments: The Role of Search Frictions and Unawareness
title_zh: 受支配的养老金投资：搜索摩擦与认知缺失的作用
title_primary: 受支配的养老金投资：搜索摩擦与认知缺失的作用

authors: Karin Kinnerud, Louise Lorentzon
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We conduct a large-scale field experiment in the Swedish pension system to examine to what extent information and search frictions explain dominated high-fee index fund choices. Three findings stand out: (i) Letters that increase awareness of a dominated choice and reduce search costs of finding the dominating alternative improve savers’ investment choices. (ii) While the average effects are positive, a majority of investors are unresponsive to information that essentially removes search costs. The inertia holds across expected gains, rejecting models with fixed adjustment costs. (iii) Lack of awareness and search costs account for at most 45 percent of dominated choices. (JEL C93, D83, G23, G51, G53, J32)
abstract_zh: 我们在瑞典养老金系统中开展了一项大规模实地实验，以探究信息和搜索摩擦在多大程度上解释了被高费率指数基金主导的劣质选择。三个主要发现如下：（i）提高对劣质选择认知度并降低寻找更优替代方案搜索成本的函件，改善了储蓄者的投资选择。（ii）尽管平均效应为正，但大多数投资者对实质上消除了搜索成本的信息无动于衷。这种惯性在预期收益范围内普遍存在，从而否定了固定调整成本模型。（iii）认知缺失和搜索成本最多只能解释45%的劣质选择。（JEL分类号：C93, D83, G23, G51, G53, J32）

title: Politics of Food: An Experiment on Trust in Expert Regulation and Economic Costs of Political Polarisation
title_zh: 食品政治：专家监管信任与政治极化经济成本的实验研究
title_primary: 食品政治：专家监管信任与政治极化经济成本的实验研究
title_secondary: Politics of Food: An Experiment on Trust in Expert Regulation and Economic Costs of Political Polarisation
authors: Christopher Burnitt, Jared Gars, Mateusz Stalinski
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Rising polarisation heightens concerns about politicising regulatory agencies, prompting reassessment of the accountability–independence trade-off. We study whether perceived out-group oversight affects trust in regulation and market behaviour. Using US television transcripts, we show that media link agencies with presidents. We then conduct a field experiment (N=5,566) using a case where the EPA endorsed antibiotic spraying on citrus crops during both Trump’s and Biden’s presidencies. Holding science constant, out-group oversight reduces support for spraying by 26%, lowers trust in EPA’s evaluation, and increases donations to an opposing NGO by 15%. In an obfuscated follow-up, citrus demand is unchanged, but effects differ by consumption habits.
abstract_zh: 摘要 日益加剧的政治极化引发了对监管机构政治化的担忧，促使人们重新审视问责与独立之间的权衡。本文研究了感知到的外群体监督是否会影响公众对监管的信任及市场行为。通过分析美国电视新闻转录文本，我们发现媒体常将监管机构与总统关联。随后，我们以美国环保署（EPA）在特朗普和拜登总统任期内均批准在柑橘作物上喷洒抗生素的案例为基础，开展了一项实地实验（样本量N=5,566）。在保持科学依据不变的情况下，外群体监督使受访者对喷洒措施的支持率下降26%，对EPA评估的信任度降低，并向反对该措施的NGO捐款增加15%。在一项隐蔽的后续实验中，柑橘需求未发生显著变化，但不同消费习惯群体的反应存在差异。

title: Output Quality, Productivity, and Demand: Evidence from the Chinese Steel Industry
title_zh: 产出质量、生产率与需求：来自中国钢铁行业的证据
title_primary: 产出质量、生产率与需求：来自中国钢铁行业的证据
title_secondary: Output Quality, Productivity, and Demand: Evidence from the Chinese Steel Industry
authors: Jing Li, Shengyu Li, Hongsong Zhang
official: 官方在线 2026-06-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Unobserved objective output quality complicates the analysis of firm productivity and demand because higher‐quality products entail higher costs but offer greater consumption benefits. Using a panel of firms with output quality data, we decompose quantity‐based productivity into fundamental productivity and the costs of quality, and separate the demand residual into fundamental demand and quality benefits. Fundamental demand accounts for most revenue variation, whereas quality's revenue‐enhancing benefits are largely offset by its costs. During the 2008 global financial crisis, shifts in quality diverged from changes in fundamental productivity and demand, highlighting the role of quality in assessing firm and industry performance.
abstract_zh: 未观测到的客观产出质量使企业生产率与需求分析复杂化，因为更高质量的产品虽带来更高成本，却提供更大的消费效用。基于包含产出质量数据的企业面板数据，我们将基于数量的生产率分解为基础生产率与质量成本，并将需求残差分离为基础需求与质量收益。基础需求解释了大部分收入变动，而质量带来的收入提升效应在很大程度上被其成本所抵消。在2008年全球金融危机期间，质量变动与基础生产率及需求变化呈现分化态势，凸显了质量在评估企业与行业绩效中的关键作用。

title: Post-disaster aid and development of the manufacturing sector: Lessons from a natural experiment in China revisited
title_zh: 灾后援助与制造业发展：基于中国自然实验的再审视

authors: Sherzod B. Akhundjanov
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Bulte et al. (2018), examining the effects of the 2008 earthquake in China, report quasi-experimental evidence of Dutch Disease dynamics in the context of post-disaster aid and recovery. The authors’ conclusion from the synthetic control analysis relies exclusively on visual inspection of the post-earthquake gap between the treated unit and its synthetic control, without implementing the method’s formal inferential procedures. Our reanalysis shows that, while the gap may appear visually large and persistent over time, it is not statistically significant. Within the synthetic control framework, we find no evidence supporting aid-induced Dutch Disease dynamics. This weakens the original study’s conclusion by showing that the reported effect is not robust to alternative methods.
abstract_zh: Bulte等人（2018）在考察2008年中国地震影响时，报告了灾后援助与恢复背景下荷兰病动态的准实验证据。作者基于合成控制分析得出的结论，仅依赖于对处理单元与其合成控制之间地震后差距的视觉检查，而未实施该方法的正式推断程序。我们的再分析表明，尽管这一差距在视觉上可能显得较大且随时间持续存在，但在统计上并不显著。在合成控制框架内，我们未发现支持援助引发的荷兰病动态的证据。这通过表明所报告效应在替代方法下不具稳健性，削弱了原研究的结论。

title: Reintegrating Older Long-Term Unemployed Workers: The Impact of Temporary Job Guarantees
title_zh: 重新整合长期失业的年长工人：临时工作保障的影响
title_primary: 重新整合长期失业的年长工人：临时工作保障的影响
title_secondary: Reintegrating Older Long-Term Unemployed Workers: The Impact of Temporary Job Guarantees
authors: Ahammer, Alexander, Halla, Martin, Heckl, Pia, Winter-Ebmer, Rudolf
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Long-term unemployment among older workers is particularly difficult to overcome. We study the impacts of a large-scale job guarantee program that offered up to two years of fully subsidized employment to long-term unemployed individuals aged 50 and above. Using a sharp age-based discontinuity in eligibility, we find that participation increased regular, unsubsidized employment by 43 percentage points two years after the program ended. The gains are driven by transitions into new firms and industries, rather than continued subsidized employment, and we find no evidence of displacement effects for non-participants or spillovers to family members. The program had no measurable short-run health effects.
abstract_zh: 老年劳动者面临的长期失业问题尤为棘手。我们研究了一项大规模就业保障计划的影响，该计划为50岁及以上的长期失业者提供长达两年的全额补贴就业。利用基于年龄的严格断点设计，我们发现，参与该计划使参与者在项目结束两年后的常规非补贴就业率提高了43个百分点。这些收益主要源于向新企业和行业的转移，而非持续补贴就业，且我们未发现对非参与者产生替代效应或对家庭成员产生外溢效应的证据。该计划在短期内未对健康产生可测量的影响。

title: When neighbors stop knocking: The impact of Canada’s 2025 tourism decline on U.S. local labor markets
title_zh: 当邻居不再敲门：加拿大2025年旅游业下滑对美国地方劳动力市场的影响
title_primary: 当邻居不再敲门：加拿大2025年旅游业下滑对美国地方劳动力市场的影响
title_secondary: When neighbors stop knocking: The impact of Canada’s 2025 tourism decline on U.S. local labor markets
authors: André Kurmann, Etienne Lalé, Julien Martin
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We provide the first systematic evidence on the short-run labor market consequences of the 25% decline in Canadian visits to the United States in 2025. We combine smartphone foot-traffic data measuring Canadian visitor presence at the ZIP code × industry level with real-time establishment-level employment records. Exploiting the high heterogeneity in exposure to Canadian visits, we find that small establishments in the top 1% exposed local-industry markets experienced employment declines of about 6% compared to less exposed ones. Our estimates imply between 13,900 and 42,100 jobs lost, concentrated in a small number of localities.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了关于2025年加拿大赴美访问量下降25%对短期劳动力市场影响的首个系统性证据。我们将衡量加拿大游客在邮政编码×行业层面存在的智能手机人流数据，与实时企业层面的就业记录相结合。利用加拿大访问暴露度的高度异质性，我们发现，在暴露度最高的1%本地行业市场中，小型企业的就业相比暴露度较低的企业下降了约6%。我们的估计表明，约有13,900至42,100个工作岗位流失，且集中在少数地区。

title: Monetary policy transmission through the exchange rate factor structure
title_zh: 汇率因子结构下的货币政策传导
title_primary: 汇率因子结构下的货币政策传导
title_secondary: Monetary policy transmission through the exchange rate factor structure
authors: Erik Loualiche, Alexandre R. Pecora, Fabricius Somogyi, Colin Ward
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-16 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We show that US monetary policy is transmitted internationally through the factor structure of exchange rates. Following an easing of monetary policy, investment funds sell safe and buy risky currencies. Global US banks, similarly, tilt their distribution of foreign loan origination toward currencies with greater systematic currency risk. The effects of monetary policy on currency flows and loans persist for several months and feed into the leverage and real investment decisions of firms and, in particular, those that operate using a high-risk currency. We conclude that the risk factor exposure of currencies is a significant channel through which we can understand the international transmission of US monetary policy.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，美国货币政策通过汇率的因子结构在国际间传导。在货币政策宽松之后，投资基金卖出安全货币并买入风险货币。同样，全球美国银行将其外国贷款发放的分布倾向于具有更高系统性货币风险的货币。货币政策对货币流动和贷款的影响持续数月，并渗透到企业的杠杆和实际投资决策中，尤其是那些使用高风险货币运营的企业。我们得出结论，货币的风险因子暴露是理解美国货币政策国际传导的重要渠道。

title: Supercompliers
title_zh: 超级合规者
title_primary: 超级合规者
title_secondary: Supercompliers
authors: Matthew L. Comey, Amanda R. Eng, Pauline Leung, Zhuan Pei
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-15 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In an instrumental variable framework, we define supercompliers as the subpopulation whose treatment take-up positively responds to eligibility and whose outcome positively responds to take-up. Supercompliers are the only subpopulation to benefit from treatment eligibility and, hence, are important for policy evaluation. We propose conditions for characterizing supercompliers, and show how estimation and inference can be conducted with instrumental variable regression. In two job training experiments, we demonstrate our machinery’s utility, particularly in incorporating social welfare weights into marginal value of public funds analyses.
abstract_zh: 在工具变量框架下，我们将“超级依从者”定义为治疗接受度对资格条件呈正向响应、且结果对治疗接受度呈正向响应的子群体。超级依从者是唯一从治疗资格中获益的子群体，因此对政策评估具有重要意义。我们提出了刻画超级依从者的条件，并展示了如何利用工具变量回归进行估计与推断。在两个职业培训实验中，我们展示了该方法的实用性，特别是在将社会福利权重纳入公共资金边际价值分析中的应用。

title: The disappearance of malaria from Denmark, 1862–1900
title_secondary: The disappearance of malaria from Denmark, 1862–1900
authors: Mathias Mølbak Ingholt, Maarten van Wijhe, Lone Simonsen, Daniel Weinberger
official: 官方在线 2026-04-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The reason for malaria's disappearance from northwestern Europe in the early twentieth century has long been discussed but remains an unresolved conundrum. This is partially due to a previous focus on the early modern era, and partially because various theories have never been tested against each other. In this study, we test some of the proposed hypotheses using nineteenth‐century Denmark as a case. We found that the accelerating agricultural improvements with drainage and increasing livestock per km 2 explained much of the declining incidence rates, whilst other factors such as household size, temperatures, and precipitation did not seem to matter. Increased drainage meant dryer surface environment, and this led to a reduced size of the mosquito populations and therefore fewer malaria infections, and increased access to livestock led to changes in the mosquitoes’ feeding preferences. Whilst drainage may have played a key role, it is possible that improvements in housing and clothing materials as well as use of quinine could also have affected malaria trends, although this could not be tested. We conclude that the disappearance of malaria was likely an unanticipated benefit of the agricultural developments related to the modernization of rural Denmark during the nineteenth century.
abstract_zh: 疟疾在二十世纪初从西北欧消失的原因长期以来一直备受讨论，但至今仍是一个未解之谜。这在一定程度上是因为以往的研究聚焦于近代早期，部分原因则是各种理论从未被相互检验过。在本研究中，我们以十九世纪的丹麦为案例，检验了一些提出的假说。我们发现，加速的农业改良，包括排水系统的改善和每平方公里牲畜数量的增加，在很大程度上解释了发病率的下降趋势，而其他因素如家庭规模、气温和降水量似乎并未产生影响。排水改善意味着地表环境更加干燥，这导致蚊虫种群数量减少，从而减少了疟疾感染；而牲畜可及性的增加则改变了蚊虫的吸血偏好。尽管排水可能起到了关键作用，但住房和衣物材料的改进以及奎宁的使用也可能影响了疟疾的趋势，尽管这一点无法得到验证。我们得出结论，疟疾的消失很可能是十九世纪丹麦农村现代化进程中农业发展所带来的意外益处。

title: Fog or smog? The impact of uncensored reporting on pollution on individuals’ environmental preferences
title_zh: 雾还是霾？无审查污染报道对个人环境偏好的影响
title_primary: 雾还是霾？无审查污染报道对个人环境偏好的影响
title_secondary: Fog or smog? The impact of uncensored reporting on pollution on individuals’ environmental preferences
authors: Sven A. Hartmann
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper analyzes the causal effect of exposure to uncensored environmental reporting on individuals’ environmental preferences and pro-environmental behavior. We exploit a natural experiment occurring in the German Democratic Republic, where geographic characteristics determined access to Western TV. Western media provided information on environmental pollution, a topic censored in East German state media. Using individual-level data from the German Socio-Economic Panel, we find a positive and persistent effect of Western TV exposure on environmental concerns and participation in environmental organizations. Complementing these findings, the analysis of county-level data reveals additional changes in pro-environmental behavior. Specifically, we show that Western TV induced GDR citizens to submit complaint letters on environmental issues to local authorities. Furthermore, regions with Western TV access exhibited stronger electoral support for the Green Party in the first two federal elections of reunified Germany. These results highlight the influential role of mass media in shaping both environmental preferences and corresponding behavior.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了接触未经审查的环境报道对个人环境偏好及亲环境行为的因果效应。我们利用德意志民主共和国发生的一项自然实验，其中地理特征决定了西德电视的接入情况。西方媒体提供了关于环境污染的信息，而这一话题在东德国家媒体中受到审查。利用德国社会经济面板数据的个体层面数据，我们发现西德电视接触对环境关注及参与环保组织具有积极且持久的影响。为补充这些发现，县级数据的分析揭示了亲环境行为的额外变化。具体而言，我们表明西德电视促使东德公民向地方当局提交关于环境问题的投诉信。此外，在统一后德国的前两次联邦选举中，能够接入西德电视的地区表现出对绿党更强的选举支持。这些结果凸显了大众媒体在塑造环境偏好及相应行为方面的关键作用。

title: The opacity-reducing effect of digital transformation on firms’ financial reporting
title_zh: 数字化转型对企业财务报告透明度降低效应的研究
title_primary: 数字化转型对企业财务报告透明度降低效应的研究
title_secondary: The opacity-reducing effect of digital transformation on firms’ financial reporting
authors: Li Zhao, Guo Wu
official: 官方在线 2025-09-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: As digital transformation (DT) reshapes global business, its impact on financial reporting quality is critical for market transparency. We investigate the impact of DT on financial reporting opacity (FRO), proxied by the absolute value of discretionary accruals, for Chinese A-share listed firms from 2008 to 2023. Our findings reveal that: (1) DT significantly reduces FRO; (2) The FRO-reducing impact is mediated by internal control (IC) quality; (3) External scrutiny moderates the negative relationship between DT and FRO; (4) The results hold across various robustness checks and endogeneity treatments, including propensity score matching, quantile regressions, lagged variables, and an instrumental variable approach; (5) Heterogeneity analyses suggest that the beneficial effect of DT on FRO is more pronounced for labour-intensive firms, non-state-owned firms, and non-financial firms. We also provide implications for managers, investors, and policymakers.
